params.body:
## What

The activity figures on Beheer > Inzichten > Gebruik no longer count the work of platform staff.

A platform administrator is a user of a garage like anybody else, so everything he did was written under that garage. The garage the administrators belong to led the garage table with figures that were mostly the platform at work on itself. An administrator working inside a garage's account ("Inloggen als") wrote under that garage's own user.

**Stacked on #919.** This branch contains that commit, so until #919 is merged the diff here shows both. Merge #919 first and this one shows only its own commit (`9125695`).

## One definition

`App\Support\Staff`: a user whose role is platform administrator (`User::isAdmin()`). A role and not a list, so it follows people coming and going. `InsightsRepository::DEMO` (a mail domain plus two named customer sheets) is a filter on demo data for the offers and order forms of Inzichten and is left as it is.

## Per measure

| Measure | Staff under their own account | Staff inside a garage's account |
|---|---|---|
| Handelingen: car entered | left out by the reader on `vehicles.created_by`, history included | left out when `created_at` falls inside a logged delegation of that user, history included |
| Handelingen: offer, order form | same, on `created_by` | same |
| Handelingen: Car-Pass, VIN, AutoConnect | same, on `user_id` | same |
| Handelingen: bid | not filtered: `export_bids` keeps the bidding garage, no person | not filtered |
| Handelingen: lead | written by a customer, nobody to leave out | n/a |
| Bewerkingen, Aanmeldingen | left out by the reader on `activity_events.user_id`, history included | history: left out inside a logged delegation. From now on not written while delegating |
| Schermen geopend, Stocklist geopend | left out by the reader on `activity_page_views.user_id`, history included | from now on not counted while delegating. History stays: a daily total has no moment to compare |
| Bekeken in stocklist, Bekeken door collega's | from now on not written when the viewer is staff. History stays: the tables keep a garage, no viewer | same |
| Bekeken in widget, Bekeken op website, Widget geopend | visitors without a sign-in, unchanged | unchanged |

A car without a person behind it (import feed, partner API, `created_by` empty) stays in the handlings.

A delegation that was never stopped ends a session's lifetime after its last recorded write, or after its start when it wrote nothing.

## Storage

No migration and no new column.

- `activity_events` and `activity_page_views`: an administrator's own rows are written as before. Nothing is written while delegating.
- `vehicle_views` (side `platform` and `own`) and `vehicle_lookups`: nothing is written when the viewer is staff or delegating. This also lowers the count a dealer sees on his own car (R S2-5.27) by the views staff made.

## Screen

One quiet line above the measure list, in four languages: "Zonder het werk van platformbeheerders, ook wanneer ze in het account van een garage werken." The measure list, the chart and the garage table read the same rows, so they give the same total. The cache key moves to `activity.screen.8`.

## Known limits

- Staff is who holds the role today. Somebody who becomes an administrator leaves the figures for his earlier period as well; somebody who stops being one returns to them.
- Bids placed by staff, or during a delegation, stay in the handlings.
- Page views and car views made during a delegation before this deploy stay, as do car views by administrators before it.
- `vehicles.created_by` is not a user id on every creation path (some write no usable value); such a car counts as having no person.

## Rules and tests

- New rule P3-16.26; P3-16.25 no longer says an administrator counts under his garage.
- `PlatformStaffAreNotAGarageTest` (9 tests): an administrator's edits, sign-ins, screens and stocklist opens do not appear under his garage while his rows stay written, a garage user's do; the same for a car entered and a lookup; a car opened by staff writes nothing on either end; nothing is counted during a delegated session and the garage user counts again afterwards; rows inside a logged delegation are taken out of history; an open delegation ends with its session; the screen says the line; list, chart and table agree.
- Three existing tests used an administrator as the acting person and now use a garage user.

## Checked

- Full suite locally: 2757 tests green. PHPStan: no errors. Pint on the two new files.
params.title: Activity: the figures leave platform staff and delegated sessions out
